key_highlights: ASX finished flat as miners rose but oil stocks struggled; IDP (IDP.AX) plummeted on earnings
RBA set to hike rates again amid sticky inflation, squeezing household spending and testing credibility
Aussie flash PMI sags, signalling softening domestic demand
Oil prices jump on Iran conflict; JPMorgan admits inability to forecast direction
Tech stocks lead ASX higher post Wall Street surge; oil snaps losing run
Property market cools: rising listings, falling demand driving prices lower
Critical Resources (CRG.AX) surges on Suriname gold; Aurum (AUG.AX) raises $52.5M for West African gold
Jetstar (JLH.AX) industrial action escalates with fee waivers
China property recovery question and rebalancing towards robotics sector
Federal/state governments facing debt cliff; energy cost policy debate intensifies

sectors.trend: Miners rose to support ASX; gold miners (CRG.AX, AUG.AX) surge on new project milestones; rare earths (JUP.AX) gain on Critica offtake interest. Iron ore stable but China property recovery uncertain.
sectors.implications: Gold and rare earths sub-sectors outperforming; diversified miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) benefit from broad commodity support. China demand question is key swing factor.

sectors.trend: Oil stocks struggled despite price jump on Iran conflict; PE deals in oil/gas tumbling as buyout pipeline dries up. Domestic energy cost policy debate (nuclear, EV chargers) ongoing.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) face mixed signals: higher oil prices vs. weak M&A activity. Domestic energy policy uncertainty weighs on sentiment.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes continue, supporting NIMs but squeezing household spending. Debt cliff for governments raises sovereign credit concerns. IDP (IDP.AX) plummets.
sectors.implications: Big 4 (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) benefit from higher rates short-term but face credit risk from squeezed households. Government debt trajectory a medium-term concern.

sectors.trend: Tech stocks led ASX higher post Wall Street surge. $16B Aussie tech firm faces China link controversy. AI sector globally active (Okta, Google/Nvidia chip race).
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global AI momentum. China-linked firms face geopolitical risk premium.

sectors.trend: Jetstar (JLH.AX) industrial action escalates. Household spending squeezed by RBA hikes. Half of young adults living with parents signals weak consumer confidence. Qantas (QAN.AX) announces SYD-JFK non-stop.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary under pressure. Qantas long-haul expansion is positive but Jetstar disruption risks near-term revenue.

sectors.trend: Syngenis (SYG.AX) gains precision medicine venture. Property prices falling on rising listings and weak demand. El Nino threatens agricultural REITs.
sectors.implications: Healthcare defensive appeal intact. Property REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face headwinds from falling prices and higher rates.

key_themes: RBA rate hike cycle vs. sticky inflation and household affordability
Global bond market pressure and US fiscal credibility concerns
Iran conflict driving oil volatility and energy security debate
China property recovery and robotics rebalancing as demand catalyst
Australian PMI softening signals domestic demand weakness
Property market correction: rising supply, falling demand
Energy policy: nuclear debate, EV infrastructure costs, fuel buffer depletion
Government debt sustainability across federal and state levels

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hikes exceeding market expectations, deepening household stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight financials for NIM benefit; underweight rate-sensitive REITs and consumer discretionary

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iran conflict escalation causing oil price spike and fuel supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor WDS.AX, STO.AX; consider fuel-cost-sensitive transport names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global bond market selloff and US fiscal credibility erosion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration risk; favour short-dated bonds; monitor AUD/USD for carry trade unwinding

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Australian PMI weakness signalling demand contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour defensive sectors (healthcare, staples); monitor CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Government debt cliff and fiscal sustainability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor sovereign credit ratings; favour cash-rich, low-debt equities

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Jetstar industrial action disrupting Qantas Group revenue
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid JLH.AX short-term; QAN.AX (QAN.AX) less exposed

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare earths miners on project catalysts and safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: CRG.AX Suriname grab, AUG.AX $52.5M raise, JUP.AX offtake interest; Iran conflict supports gold

opportunities.recommendation: Add to Big 4 banks for NIM expansion from continued RBA hikes
opportunities.rationale: Rate cycle supports margins; credit risk manageable near-term despite household stress

opportunities.recommendation: Selective tech exposure on global AI momentum
opportunities.rationale: Tech led ASX higher; AI security and chip demand structural tailwind
Syngenis precision medicine catalyst; sector resilience in rate-hike environment

defensive_moves.rationale: Falling prices, rising supply, higher rates create triple headwind for property sector

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge oil-price volatility; avoid long oil exposure without directional conviction
defensive_moves.rationale: JPMorgan cannot forecast oil; Iran conflict creates two-way risk; PE deal pipeline drying up

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid consumer discretionary and rate-sensitive names
defensive_moves.rationale: PMI sags, household spending squeezed, young adults financially constrained

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with volatility. Miners and tech provide support; oil, REITs, and consumer drag. RBA hike and PMI data create headwinds. Iran oil risk is wildcard. Expect 1-2% range around current levels.
market_outlook.long_term: Moderate constructive if RBA peaks and China property stabilises. Structural themes: AI/tech, critical minerals, healthcare. Risks: fiscal debt, El Nino agricultural impact, energy transition costs. 6-12 month ASX 200 target modestly higher on earnings recovery.
